name: m4-forkvar-gc-confirm

variantDescriptions.fixyoung: base with `-Xmn3g -XX:-G1UseAdaptiveIHOP`, the compiler labs' default from doc/variance.md, scaled to this campaign's 8 GB heap
variantDescriptions.fixyounghc3: fixyoung with `-XX:hashCode=3`: identity hashes from a global counter, for campaigns judged on instructions per op
variantDescriptions.xbatchfix: fixyoung with `-Xbatch`: compiles block the requesting thread, so allocation is nearly deterministic

description: Confirms m4-forkvar-gc (stopped after 3 forks a variant) and m4-forkvar-hash with 6 forks a variant: does a fixed young generation cut fork-to-fork CV of time per op, and do `-XX:hashCode=3` or `-Xbatch` on top of it cut the CV of instructions per op? Compare each variant's CV across forks (an F-test of variances, or Levene's), not their means: `-Xbatch` and `hashCode=3` change the work done.
